style_summary: Part 3 of Everyday Riso: a recurring cheerful grandfather with a round paper-white beard, small round glasses and an olive cardigan — morning exercise, the paper, slow tea and a walk with an old friend — in the same three-ink orange, olive and near-black risograph system on cream paper, with exactly one absurdly oversized object, visible misregistration and halftone grain, and one tiny black corner label.

environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: Runtime injection of the prioritized CORE and FLEX anchors from this spec.
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Runtime injection of the source-specific exclusions from this spec.
environment_variables.SUBJECT: The recurring cheerful grandfather: bald head, round fluffy paper-white beard (bare paper, never white ink), small round black glasses and expression within the rounded chunky character system.
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: The everyday action and the readable physical contact between the person and the oversized object.
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: The single absurdly oversized everyday object, its ink colors and what exactly is exaggerated.
environment_variables.LOCATION: The everyday setting, reduced to the minimum needed to read the action.
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: The few normal-scale supporting items and ground shadow; everything else stays open cream paper.
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: The tiny corner label: a 2–3 word uppercase phrase, exact spelling, no punctuation.
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: Additional wording; this style uses none, so the value is normally "none".
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: Separator or decorative mark; this style uses none, so the value is normally "none".
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: The grandfather's fixed outfit — olive cardigan, orange trousers, black slippers — in orange, olive and black ink only.
environment_variables.DESIGN_INTENTION: Why the oversized object makes the everyday moment funny and warm, and how it shapes the poster.
environment_variables.RATIO_COMPOSITION: Separate 9:16 and 16:9 composition plans; apply only the plan matching ASPECT_RATIO.

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Strict three-ink risograph on cream paper #F4EBDD: warm orange #FF6C2F and olive green #5E6B3A as broad masses, near-black #1E1E1E only for tiny eyes, thin round glasses, the label and slippers. Brown appears only where orange overprints olive.

[CORE] The print must look physically printed: 1–3 px misregistration between ink layers, fine grain with patchy uneven coverage, coarse halftone or stipple dots for every shade, translucent overprint. No smooth digital gradient, airbrush, 3D or glow.

[CORE] One recurring character: a cheerful elderly man with the series build — rounded blocky body, soft thick limbs, small bald head, big soft hands — a round paper-white beard and side hair left as bare cream paper (never white ink), small round black glasses, skin as pale orange halftone, and an olive cardigan, orange trousers and black slippers. Comfortable, never frail or sad.

[CORE] Exactly one everyday object is absurdly oversized; the person and all other props stay at normal series proportions. The action is a plain daily routine and the mood is relaxed, warm and funny.
[CORE] Exactly one tiny bold black sans-serif label of 2–3 uppercase words in a free top corner, about 1.7 percent of canvas height, in one or two lines; no headline and no other wording.
[FLEX] Pose and direction vary per case (sit, stand on tiptoe, kneel, squat, walk, ride) so a set of four never repeats one posture.
[FLEX] The oversized object may bleed off one or two edges; its placement, crop and which corner holds the label are recomposed for each ratio.
[FLEX] Which garments and props take orange versus olive can change per case, as long as the three-ink limit and overprint brown are respected.
[FLEX] Supporting props (chair, stool, clothesline, bowl, basket, watering can) and a soft stipple ground shadow are allowed when they explain the action; settings otherwise stay open cream paper.
source_content_to_avoid: The previous Chromatic Gesture Characters palette: hot pink, coral-pink skin, cobalt blue, emerald and any other color outside orange, olive, near-black and overprint brown.
The previous series' smooth airbrush or spray-gradient shading and soft digital glow.
Subjects, props, captions and poses copied from the earlier reference posters of the sibling series.
Surreal, dreamlike or abstract concept themes such as a body turning into landscape, which the brief identifies as underperforming.
Any watermark, social handle, creator ID, platform logo, brand logo, QR code or signature.

visual_deconstruction.reference_observation: Part 3 keeps the Everyday Riso system and swaps in a recurring cheerful grandfather with a round paper-white beard, small round glasses, olive cardigan, orange trousers and black slippers. Each poster shows one daily moment of his with exactly one absurdly oversized object, coarse halftone shading, orange-over-olive brown overprint, visible misregistration and a tiny black label in a top corner.
visual_deconstruction.style_content_separation: Reusable: the three-ink riso system, print texture, chunky character build, single-object exaggeration formula, open cream space and the tiny corner label. Case-specific: the particular action, the oversized object, the label wording and each scene's placement.
visual_deconstruction.creative_scope: Formula-driven reinterpretation: any ordinary daily action plus exactly one absurdly oversized object, rendered in the fixed character and ink system. The reader should be able to say 'a person is ___, but the ___ is absurdly huge' within three seconds.
visual_deconstruction.hierarchy: The oversized object reads first as the largest ink mass, the person's face and contact point second, open cream space third, and the tiny label last.

composition.canvas: Edge-to-edge cream paper poster with no frame, mockup, border or panel division.
composition.subject_scale: Person plus oversized object occupy about 60–80 percent of the canvas; the rest is calm cream negative space.
composition.exaggeration_rule: Only one object is enlarged. Its contact with the person (lips, hands, brush, clothespin, watering-can drops, basket) must stay visible and readable.
composition.cropping: The oversized object may be cropped by one or two canvas edges for tension; the person's face, hands and action are never cropped.
composition.ratio_strategy: Portrait uses the height for the object to tower, hang or loop vertically. Landscape re-composes the same case across the width — the object sweeps, stretches or lies laterally — instead of cropping or padding the portrait.
composition.pose_variety: Within a set of four, vary the action direction: sitting, standing, kneeling, squatting, walking or riding.

typography.label: Exactly one label: bold black grotesk sans-serif, uppercase, 2–3 words, set in one or two flush-left lines.
typography.size: Tiny: cap height about 1.7 percent of canvas height, block no wider than 25 percent of canvas width.
typography.placement: A free top-left or top-right corner with clear margin, never touching or overlapping the subject or the oversized object.
typography.wording: Render MAIN_TEXT exactly once with no added punctuation. No headline, subtitle, secondary text, accent symbol, signature or brand.

color_palette.paper: #F4EBDD warm cream, fibrous, visible as the background and as cutout highlights.
inks: #FF6C2F warm orange — primary ink for broad masses: oversized objects, garments, skin halftone.
#5E6B3A olive green — secondary ink for garments, furniture, plants, stems and contours.
#1E1E1E near-black — detail ink only for tiny eyes, thin round glasses, the label and slippers; the beard and hair stay bare paper.
color_palette.overprint: Deep brown appears only where translucent orange prints over olive; it is used for stripes, tape, coffee, soil and shadows.
color_palette.forbidden: No pink, magenta, cobalt or any blue, purple, yellow, white ink or gray wash; no fifth ink.
color_palette.flexibility: The ink roles are fixed; how much orange versus olive each case uses can change.

image_treatment.medium: Flat, chunky character illustration printed as a three-color risograph.
image_treatment.texture: Visible 1–3 px registration offset leaving thin paper or overprint edges, fine ink grain, mild patchy uneven coverage, matte ink on fibrous cream paper.
image_treatment.shading: Coarse halftone dots and stipple only; soft stipple ground shadows under feet, chairs and objects. No smooth tonal gradients.
image_treatment.character_rendering: Rounded simplified silhouettes without outlines; skin is pale orange halftone over cream; facial features use olive or brown overprint with tiny black eyes. The grandfather's beard and hair are unprinted cream paper shaped by the surrounding ink, never white ink.

design_rules: Pass the three-second test: a person is doing an everyday action, but one object is absurdly huge.
Enlarge exactly one object and keep the person, hands and every other item at normal series proportions.
Use only orange, olive and near-black ink on cream paper, with brown only as orange-over-olive overprint.
Make the riso print texture obvious at full view: misregistration, grain, halftone and overprint.
Keep the label tiny, black and in a free top corner, and render no other text.
Compose each ratio separately; the 16:9 version re-plans the scene across the width instead of cropping the portrait.
do: Choose a grandfather's ordinary daily routines: morning exercise, reading the paper, tea, a walk, gardening, board games, naps, fishing.
Give the grandfather a relaxed, happy face with curved closed eyes behind small round glasses and a gentle smile under the round beard.
Let the oversized object bleed off an edge when it adds tension.
Leave generous calm cream negative space.
Vary poses across a set of four so the series reads as a family, not a template.
avoid: Pink, cobalt or any blue, purple, yellow or extra fifth color.
Smooth airbrush gradients, glossy highlights, 3D rendering, glow or photorealistic lighting.
Surreal, dreamlike or abstract concepts, or more than one oversized element, giant heads or gigantic hands.
Tense, cool or serious expressions and fashion poses.
Large headlines, extra wording, logos, watermarks or handles.
Busy backgrounds, scenery or multiple people.
negative_prompt: pink, magenta, coral-pink skin, blue, cobalt, purple, yellow ink, white ink, gray wash, fifth ink color, smooth airbrush or spray gradient, digital flat fill without grain, 3D render, glossy highlights, glow, realistic lighting, photorealism, surreal transformation, dreamscape, body becoming landscape, more than one oversized object, giant head, gigantic hands, extra limbs, extra fingers, second person, tense or cool expression, large headline, extra words, misspelled label, punctuation in label, logo, watermark, social handle, QR code, signature, border, mockup frame, busy background, contact sheet, white ink beard, young person, female character, frail or sad elderly man

values.SUBJECT: One short, stocky, cheerful grandfather — the same character in every case: relatively small bald head with short hair at the sides, a prominent round fluffy beard, small thin round black glasses, round orange nose, relaxed curved eyes and a smiling mouth; hair and beard are bare unprinted cream paper, never white ink. Pleased and effortless.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Stands comfortably with knees gently flexed, raising the dumbbell above his head with both hands gripping the middle bar; face unobscured.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: ONE gigantic orange dumbbell — one short continuous bar joining two rounded weight ends — larger than his entire body; only the dumbbell is oversized.
values.LOCATION: Morning exercise on an open cream ground, no gym.
values.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: Cream paper and a soft olive stipple ground shadow under the slippers; no second dumbbell, no sweat.
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: Olive cardigan with rounded sleeves, wide orange trousers and black cloth slippers.
values.DESIGN_INTENTION: The weight is absurd but his face is calm and pleased, turning a morning workout into a gentle joke about starting the day strong.
values.RATIO_COMPOSITION: For 9:16: the dumbbell spans the upper half and crops at the left and right edges; the grandfather stands in the lower half; label in the top-right corner. For 16:9: the grandfather stands at left-center with the dumbbell held high across the upper-left two-thirds, one weight cropped at the top edge; label in the free top-right area.

values.SUBJECT: One short, stocky, cheerful grandfather — the same character in every case: relatively small bald head with short hair at the sides, a prominent round fluffy beard, small thin round black glasses, round orange nose, relaxed curved eyes and a smiling mouth; hair and beard are bare unprinted cream paper, never white ink. Relaxed and smiling as he reads.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Reclines in an ordinary olive armchair holding the lower edges of the newspaper with both soft hands, his small head and round beard peeking from one side; slippers visible below.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: ONE unfolded two-page newspaper as large as a wall: cream unprinted paper with broad orange column blocks and narrow olive line marks, no readable words; only the newspaper is oversized.
values.LOCATION: A quiet morning read in an armchair on open cream paper.
values.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: A normal olive armchair and a soft stipple ground shadow; no room, table or lamp.
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: Olive cardigan with rounded sleeves, wide orange trousers and black cloth slippers.
values.DESIGN_INTENTION: The wall-sized paper makes the daily headlines literally big while the reclining pose stays completely relaxed.
values.RATIO_COMPOSITION: For 9:16: the newspaper fills the upper and right frame, the grandfather sits at the lower-left in the armchair peeking around its left edge; label in the top-left corner. For 16:9: the armchair sits at left-center and the open newspaper spreads across the right two-thirds, cropping at the top and right edges; label in the top-left corner.

values.SUBJECT: One short, stocky, cheerful grandfather — the same character in every case: relatively small bald head with short hair at the sides, a prominent round fluffy beard, small thin round black glasses, round orange nose, relaxed curved eyes and a smiling mouth; hair and beard are bare unprinted cream paper, never white ink. Eyes pleased as he blows on his tea.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Sits relaxed in profile on a small ordinary stool, holding a normal tiny orange teacup near his lips and gently blowing across it.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: ONE single continuous steam plume rising from the ordinary cup and curling into a huge soft coil about twice his seated height, rendered in very sparse olive halftone over bare cream with a delicate orange offset rim; only the steam is oversized, the cup stays tiny.
values.LOCATION: A slow tea moment on an open cream ground.
values.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: A normal small olive stool and a soft stipple ground shadow; no clouds, sky or weather elements.
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: Olive cardigan with rounded sleeves, wide orange trousers and black cloth slippers.
values.DESIGN_INTENTION: The giant airy plume turns one small cup of tea into the whole poster, making the slowness of the moment visible.
values.RATIO_COMPOSITION: For 9:16: the grandfather sits in the lower half and the steam coils up through the upper frame; label in the top-right corner. For 16:9: the grandfather sits at left-center and the steam rises and sweeps horizontally across the top-left to center, cropped at the left edge; label in the top-right corner.

values.SUBJECT: One short, stocky, cheerful grandfather — the same character in every case: relatively small bald head with short hair at the sides, a prominent round fluffy beard, small thin round black glasses, round orange nose, relaxed curved eyes and a smiling mouth; hair and beard are bare unprinted cream paper, never white ink. Smiling with curved closed eyes.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Strolls slowly beside the tortoise, one foot mid-step and both hands relaxed, both facing the same direction on the same simple ground.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: ONE enormous friendly tortoise about three times his body mass and taller than him, with an olive dome shell, orange head and chunky short legs, smiling with closed eyes; only the tortoise is oversized, its head proportional to its giant shell.
values.LOCATION: A slow companionship walk on an open cream ground.
values.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: Cream paper and a soft olive stipple ground shadow; no leash, path or other animals.
values.WARDROBE_STYLE: Olive cardigan with rounded sleeves, wide orange trousers and black cloth slippers.
values.DESIGN_INTENTION: Two slow walkers side by side: the giant tortoise mirrors the grandfather's unhurried pace and makes the friendship warm and funny.
values.RATIO_COMPOSITION: For 9:16: the grandfather walks at the lower-left while the tortoise shell fills the upper right and crops at the right edge; label in the top-left corner. For 16:9: the grandfather walks at left-center and the full tortoise strides beside him across the right two-thirds; label in the top-left corner.
